origin: Long before kingdoms rose and fell, the Behemoth stood unmoved.
story: It does not overpower its enemies with speed — it crushes them with relentless precision. Only those who master every form of strength earn the right to stand before the Colossus.
quotes: Strength is earned, layer by layer. The mountain does not bow to force.
unlockText: Something ancient and unmoved is still standing exactly where it has always stood.
victoryText: The Colossus does not fall so much as concede. Three phases, three kinds of strength, all yours now.
rule: Complete every phase without sacrificing technique. The Behemoth respects control, not speed.
hunterAdvice: Strength is earned, layer by layer. The mountain does not bow to force.
